description: Angular component for customizing button toggle styles in a widget configuration panel, including form handling, style application, and preview updates.

classes.name: WidgetButtonToggleCustomStylePanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing custom styles of a toggle button in a widget, including form controls, style copying, and preview updates.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes style settings, form controls, and subscriptions for style change handling.

methods.name: copyStyle
methods.description: Copies style from a specified state to the current style.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Hides the popover without applying changes.

methods.name: applyCustomStyle
methods.description: Emits the current custom style as an event.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets style values based on customStyle or defaults, updates form controls and preview.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on override flags.

methods.name: updatePreviewAppearance
methods.description: Updates the appearance preview based on current form values.
